description: This file defines the LoanItemWriter class, which extends AbstractLoanItemWriter and is responsible for writing loan items during a batch process, particularly related to loan Chain of Business (COB) chunk processing. It specifies how to get the lock owner for concurrency control.

classes.name: LoanItemWriter
classes.description: A concrete class extending AbstractLoanItemWriter, responsible for handling loan item writing during COB processing. It sets the specific lock owner for concurrency control.

methods.name: LoanItemWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LoanItemWriter with a LoanLockingService.

methods.name: getLockOwner
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the specific LockOwner instance used for locking during COB chunk processing.
